name: Adventure Camp (Summer Camp)
description_short: A state-licensed full-day summer camp in Nashua for children entering grades 1 through 7. Activities include swimming, field trips, trips to NH state parks, sports, arts and crafts, and STEM. The Learning Center also runs vacation camps during the February and April school breaks.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers walk to Crown Hill Pool on Mondays and Wednesdays, where trained lifeguards are on duty along with camp staff. Children must pass a swim test (swim the length of the pool and tread water for one minute) to go past belly-button depth; retests are each Monday. Lake days at Pawtuckaway State Park are lifeguarded by the State Park.
